mod.overview: Starsiege Simulation Mod (~2000, Starsiege.cs) mounts the converted Starsiege vehicle/terrain/sound asset corpus on top of completely unmodified Base Tribes gameplay (52 stock items, 3 stock armors).
notes: Unlike Herc Havoc (which replaces weapons and chassis physics), Starsiege mounts asset volumes cleanly and verifies boot resolution via Starsiege_selftest.cs without modifying Base weapon, armor, or vehicle stats.
